integrity: The proof separates the conditional empirical-process step from the scalar Gaussian-hazard minimization. The numerical script checks only the scalar calculus and benchmark; it is not used as a substitute for the asymptotic proof. Literature comparisons retain a specific residual risk from general factor-model step-up theory.
scientific_limitations: Complete-null, fixed positive equicorrelation, fixed Gaussian likelihood-ratio parameter, and large-number-of-hypotheses asymptotics only. No finite-sample remainder is claimed. A sufficiently general published theorem for arbitrary factor-model step-up critical curves could subsume the result and remains the principal literature risk.
title: A closed-form common-factor limit for Gaussian lognormal e-BH
